module: Vehicle-side dynamometer (dyno) client: after initDyno, it sends every frame the engine speed, the engaged gear and the transmission ratios to an HTML texture (JUI) belonging to the dyno object, via queueJSUITexture executed in the GE Lua.
notes: The JS calls are 'client_init' ({vehicle = vehicle folder name, id}) and 'client_data' ({rpm, gear, gearRatio, finalRatio}); the JSON quotes are replaced by \' to fit in the JS string.

rpm comes from drivetrain.rpm (compatibility layer) and gear from electrics.values.gear_M. gearRatio = v.data.engine.gears[gear] (1 if 0 or absent), finalRatio = v.data.engine.differential (1 if 0 or absent): assumes the old jbeam engine format.
Anomaly: initDyno computes frontAxis and rearAxis (Y positions of the wheels) but does not use them.
If gear is nil or absent from the gears table, gearRatio is nil (sent as is).

initDyno.desc: Stores the dyno object and its texture, then sends it a 'client_init' initialization message. Without an object identifier, does nothing.

_textureName.desc: Name of the JUI texture on this object.

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame: sends 'client_data' to the dyno if initDyno has been called.
